name: The 267-Concept Cornerless Ample Class
definition: The twelve-coordinate class encoded exactly in `papers/ample-corners/evidence/descent/record.json`.
properties: It is cornerless and ample, has VC dimension three and 267 concepts, and is not maximum because the Sauer bound at $(n,d)=(12,3)$ is 299. Its shattered complex consists of the empty set, all 12 singletons, all 66 pairs, and the 188 triples that are not even transversals of the three four-coordinate groups. These 188 triples support its facet cubes. Every coordinate contraction has 208 concepts, and the class has no nonidentity cube automorphism.
